text: Kala ko soɓi immorde ka worɓe e ka rewɓe e ka konnguɗi e ka kuuɗe na yaadi ina hawri e kala huunde soɓunde. Kala ko laaɓi kon kadi immorde e ɗum haray ko dammbondirɗum e hawrondirɗum e kala huunde laaɓunde. Ɓen worɓe laaɓuɓe e rewɓe laaɓuɓe ko ɓe martinaaɓe e ko worɓe soɓuɓe ɓen e rewɓe soɓuɓe ɓen wowlata ɓe kon. No woodani ɓe haforaneede immorde ka Alla hiMo haforira ɗum bakkatuuji maɓɓe, no woodani ɓe arsike tedduɗo ɗum le ko Aljanna on.
